question: How is the goddess characterized as sovereign of desire and companion of the elephant-lord?
premises: She is Kāmeśvarī, sovereign of desire.
inference: The goddess is Kāmeśvarī, beloved of desire, and associated with the elephant-lord.
uncertainties: kuñjara-īśvara-gāminī may refer to riding or accompanying the elephant-lord; glossed as going-with.
plain_english: She is Kāmeśvarī, beloved of desire, and she who goes with the elephant-lord.
